facts.text: Under the GC Guarantee Pell Pledge Scholarship, Pell Grant-eligible students who maintain a 2.5 GPA receive four years of college with no increase in tuition costs.

sources.title: Scholarships & Programs of Distinction - Georgetown College
sources.quote: We guarantee that any student eligible for the Pell Grant who maintains at least a 2.5 GPA will have no increase in tuition costs for the four years of college!
